title: Unknown $42.49 charge
body: Bought the book a few weeks ago and now I get charged an extra $42.49 on my visa. I google it and apparently this company does secret charges that are hard to cancel and get refunded, and customer service sucks. Hopefully I can get this cancelled and refunded or I’ll be filing a complaint with BBB.
author: Jamiethehippy

title: Scam- unauthorized subscription
body: Total scam! I bought an overpriced book and then started to see $42.49 charged to my credit card for the last 3 months. I did not sign up for a subscription and it doesn’t even show up as a subscription to the app in the App Store, nor can it be cancelled from there. Total fraud. Do not purchase anything from Lasting Change.
author: JennD123

title: Be very careful with this company.
body: As others have said this company is very sneaky, be very aware of charges to your card. I never purchased their app, yet I received a charge of $42 on my card the other day. When I reached out to support they said it was for my app subscription. Which I NEVER consented to. I’m not even sure how this is possible since when I look in my App Store it’s not even in my list of purchases.
author: Madisonnn nnm

title: Scam
body: Downloaded. What a mistake. They’re trying to charge my credit card for $48.99 every couple days. I’ve flagged them and reported them but they won’t stop. I’ll have to get a new credit card number. Don’t download!
author: Red1960*

title: Scam
body:
Absolute scam. Company uses dark patterns to make it impossible to cancel without contacting customer support. You will forget. This app does not appear in your subscriptions, there are no reminders, there is nothing in the app or the website that makes it clear you’re on a subscription, you will pay your recurring fee, dispute the charge, fail and be left frustrated and scammed out of another quarter of fees.

Would give 0 stars if I could. 

If you want to use the product, just get the book but avoid the app at all costs. The app also isn’t a very good tracker - there’s better products out there.
author: Elliad68

title: SCAM
body: Never received a notice of an upcoming renewal, attempted to dispute a payment same date as requesting cancellation and they claim they couldn’t refund the renewal for the app as it was an e-bundle. You’ll essentially pay a recurring renewal price for an ebook which is ridiculous. The product is garbage!
author: PancakePumps

title: Can’t give it 0 stars, but thats what they are worth
body:
I purchased a book from them (which I did get), but now I seem to be in some subscription service that I cannot cancel in the app (and that I didn’t agree to), and now I have to dispute the charge to my CC. 

This is a scam I wish I had never gotten into.
author: MrsJennH

title: Scam
body: I bought the book in November. And now I have a recurring charge on my card. Requested a refund and no one is getting back to me. Stay away
author: Unicorm0m

title: Read the terms and conditions first
body:
When you go to the website, you start of with quiz on what changes you want to make or break. No where during the process does it mention payment plan. In the terms and conditions it says “subscription pricing terms” 
Payment methods and subscriptions should be transparent and be shown during the quizzing process. Not everyone reads the terms and conditions as most of sign up blindly to see what it’s about. I’ve had this for a couple months now. Honestly I’ve lost interest. So be prepared for the payment
author: Jemeskino

title: Charged extra two months later STAY AWAY
body: I bought the book in November 2023 but I did not consent to the charge of $53.99 that showed up on my credit card today. I believe it's a scam the Contact Us has never been assigned ~ don't waste you money
author: mini2z

title: Need refund
body: I have contacted the email support multiple times with no response please I need a refund
author: Jenika Wallis

title: SCAM!! DO NOT BUY OR DOWNLOAD ANYTHING
body: I have purchased their book with the app, and surprise : never received my order! Contacted their support 2 times (which they say they will answer in 24h) and nothing! DONT BUY OR DOWNLOAD ITS A SCAM!!!!! And this app is worthless.
author: sTassadar
